sloka: कृतं कर्म महत्तेन मां तदाभ्यवपद्यता ।तिष्ठता रावणद्वन्द्वे वृद्धेनापि जटायुषा ।। ५.२४.२०।।।।
transliteration: kṛtaṁ karma mahattena māṁ tadābhyavapadyatā ।tiṣṭhatā rāvaṇadvandve vṛddhenāpi jaṭāyuṣā ।। 5.24.20।।।।

translations.english: Then a dark ogress called Vinata with a terryfying look, loathsome appearance and a large sunken belly said to Sita:
